hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path"); command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm run lint --silent 2>/dev/null || echo "Lint: npm not found or no lint script"'

bash -c 'MODIFIED=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -5); if [ -n "$MODIFIED" ]; then command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm test -- --bail --findRelatedTests $MODIFIED 2>/dev/null || echo "Tests: npm not found"; fi'
